audit: Task315 clean-release database-backed download reference census
database_target: Replit managed database via executeSql; production read-only replica; development comparison
scope: Selected download-bearing path, URL, attachment, and legacy migration fields; each count is a field occurrence, not a unique document. No GCS/network existence checked.

local_fallback.route: WPQR document ID-based local cache fallback

constraints: Source/candidate filesystem checks are exact path checks; absence of a GCS key on disk is not a missing release asset.
Relative URLs/keys are not assumed local. No GCS existence or credentials checked.

Production replica and development schemas differ: development has additional WPS combined and checklist evidence-file columns with no populated values; pqr_document_file_path is absent in both schemas.
Absolute WPQR values are GCS-first, with separately checked ID-derived local fallback; an absolute-looking key does not prove a required local file.
